notes: Single page, single Common Crawl snapshot (2019-10-24) of the EPFL Transport and Mobility Laboratory (TRANSP-OR) 'PhD graduates' page, which lists 25 names. The page gives no graduation years: each person carries a 'Left on <date>' line (lab departure date), recorded here as listedYear with yearMeaning 'unstated' and the full date quoted in note; two people (Ivan Spassov, Gianluca Antonini) have no date and get listedYear null. The only employer information is 'Last known affiliation' as of the capture, which is a later/current affiliation, not a first placement; it is copied into destination/position (title split off where the page writes 'Title, Employer' or 'Title at Employer') and the full string is quoted in note so the integrator does not treat it as the first job. Typos on the page ('Assitant Professor', 'Rushlikon') are kept as written. No advisor, dissertation title or degree date is given; degree 'PhD' comes from the page heading.
